entries.name: front
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent pixel-art furniture sprite for a Godot desktop pet. Reference image: use ONLY the wooden table from the supplied seated-character image. Generate ONLY that table, no character, chair, feet, computer, objects, text or ground shadow. Match its warm medium reddish-brown wood, wide rectangular tabletop (width:depth approximately 2:1), thick straight front apron, four straight square wooden legs, dark near-black stepped pixel outline and simple horizontal wood-tone bands. Not a square coffee table. Front elevation viewed slightly from above (camera elevation about 18 degrees), long front edge horizontal, both front legs visible and rear legs partially occluded. Coarse clean pixel art, limited palette, no smoothing. Full table centered with generous transparent margin on all sides, approximately 75% canvas width. Preserve reference proportions: table total height about 60% of its front width. Genuine transparent background.

entries.name: front_right
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a single isolated pixel-art table sprite. Input 1 is the original design reference (use ONLY its table). Input 2 is the approved front table view: preserve EXACTLY that furniture design, proportions, warm brown colors, thick apron, four square straight legs, dark stepped outline, simple wood bands and coarse pixel size. Render the SAME rectangular table from a front-right three-quarter view, camera sees long front edge and short right side, yaw 45 degrees. Camera elevation remains about 18 degrees, never top-down. Real tabletop dimensions width:depth:height = 2:1:1.2. Keep the long and short edges physically consistent as it rotates. Transparent background, complete table centered, all legs uncut, generous margin. No character, chair, objects, labels, floor, shadow, ornamental braces or drawers. This is one of eight rotation frames for a game; match the approved front reference closely.
